name: U2 small nuclear RNA auxiliary factor 1

function.text: U2AF1 encodes a component of the U2 auxiliary splicing factor that contributes to recognition of 3′ splice sites during pre-mRNA processing.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Recurrent somatic U2AF1 mutations occur in myelodysplastic neoplasms. Their significance depends on the specific allele, accompanying abnormalities, and the integrated myeloid disease context.
